Hello Voaters!

I am going to try and give my first impressions of the Halo Wars 2 beta that was just released today, June 13th. I love many rts games but halo wars is my all time favorite. I have spent way too much time playing halo wars 1 and climbing the leader boards with my flaming warthogs and mac rushes. I know halo wars 1 inside and outside.

Absolute first impression: The game is buggy but it looks awesome!

The main changes I see are leader powers and resource management. Leader powers now have a level up tree. You can choose to upgrade your heal/mac/odst leader powers. It is extremely similar to the way company of heros has leader progression. The Mac Cannon is very weak in this game and I do not think it is worth the upgrade points. I recommend upgrading the veternacy trail and going for odst. INFANTRY UNITS ARE OVERPOWERED. There is a new air unit that heals infantry units. There are also more infantry units such as snipers, mantis (Starcraft marauder), and the tank of a flame thrower. Basically you make some marines for anti air, some mantis for anti vehicle, and some flame throwers to tank all the hits while the nightcrawler heals your units. Additionally, there are base unit upgrades such as Infantry levels 1, 2, and 3 and similar ones for vehicles and air.

Moving onto resources, tech level is no longer a building. There is supplies and generator power. Similar to Starcraft minerals and gas. I have been using a build that goes Supply pad, Supply pad, Supply pad, Generator, Generator. Then on my expansion base, Supply pad, Generator Generator. This provides some good early game ratio of supplies to power. Then if I make it to my third base it is usually more generator and unit buildings.

If your build is better please let me know in the comments.

I have really enjoyed how the game scales as time goes on. You really need to micro your economy well because a level 2 marine is way better than a level 1 marine. If you are caught without an army you will be punished and you will lose.

Overall, I have been enjoying the beta so far. It looks amazing and the skirmishes have tons of detail. Some bad bugs I found were "Y" abilities not working especially canister shell and some graphical clipping where the floor turns black.

Please let me know what you think about the Halo Wars 2 beta!
